title: STM32CubeIDE v2.2.0 : target doesn't run after programming using J-Link, requires reset
content:
Since updating to STM32CubeIDE v2.2.0 (and on a fresh install of v2.2.0), when I program my target STM32 (F413ZH) using a Segger J-Link, the code does not run until I power cycle the target. I’m fairly certain this issue coincided with me switching from CubeIDE 2.1.1 to 2.2.0.

I have tried all 3 reset methods in the Debugger settings (Normal, Core, ResetPin), and they all exhibit the same issue. With ResetPin selected, a scope capture of the NRST line shows it asserting only once at the beginning of programming.

I also tried STM32CubeProgrammer, with the J-Link dll update to v9.56, and it does work when the “Run after programming” box checked.

As far as I can remember I didn’t change anything in the Run configuration when switching from 2.1.1 to 2.2.0.  The GBD console log (below) shows “Starting target CPU...” and then right after “Debugger requested to halt target...Target halted” and then it is never resumed or started again. Additionally, I believe the GDB console in v2.1.1 had more at the end, like “Shutting down...” or something. It’s not clear from the log whether or not GDB is correctly releasing or closing, but based on what I’m seeing, it doesn’t seem like it is.

Has anyone encountered this problem, and have any suggestions on a fix? I would like the code to run on the target after programming without needing a power cycle. Let me know if any additional information is needed.

You have to manually press the reset button on a Nucleo board to run the FW.

With 2.1.1, it would run after programming.
